summary: Regression retest of /welcome skip-button Nav-overlap fix. Confirmed pt-32 md:pt-36 padding bump resolves the desktop overlap. Both required tests (Step 1 & Step 3) PASSED on desktop without force=True. Bonus mobile (390x844) test FAILED — Nav header still intercepts pointer events at the skip button's center, because pt-32 (128px) is not enough clearance on mobile where the Nav extends past 128px.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile viewport (390x844): fixed <header data-testid='site-nav'> subtree still intercepts pointer events at welcome-skip center (x≈312, y=128). Skip button top edge sits AT y=128 (pt-32 = 128px) but the Nav header extends below 128px on mobile (BetaBanner h-10 = 40px + Nav py-4 + logo content ≈ 128px+). Resulted in Locator.click timeout after multiple retries. Desktop (md:pt-36 = 144px) works fine because there is real 40px+ clearance.

action_items: (Optional) Bump mobile top padding further to pt-36 (144px) or pt-40 (160px) so the skip button clears the Nav on viewports < 768px. Current pt-32 (128px) only gives 0px clearance on mobile where Nav bottom edge sits around y=128. Suggested: change `pt-32 md:pt-36` to `pt-36 md:pt-36` or `pt-40 md:pt-36` in /app/frontend/src/pages/Welcome.jsx line 148.
critical_code_review_comments: The Nav-overlap clearance math in the commit message (40 + 64 = 104px) under-estimates the real mobile Nav height. On a 390px viewport the rendered Nav header bottom is at ~128-140px, not 104px. Recommend measuring with a real bounding box in the future or using a known sentinel offset constant exported from Nav.jsx.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression target: pt-32 md:pt-36 padding on Welcome.jsx root container (line 148). Verified: (1) Desktop Step 1 skip click without force=True fires handler, sends POST /api/onboarding/skip (200), sets localStorage.cm_onboarding_skipped='1', navigates to /. (2) Desktop Step 3 (after Get Started → choose path 'buyer') same behavior — PASSED. Skip button bounding box at y=144 on desktop, topmost elementFromPoint = the BUTTON itself (no nav interception). Mobile failure is a separate observation — main agent may want to fix or accept it. The original p0 desktop overlap bug from iter73 is RESOLVED.
rca of the issue: Original bug: skip button at y=96 (pt-24) was beneath fixed Nav (z-50) which extended to ~y=104. Fix: increase top padding to push button below Nav. pt-32 md:pt-36 succeeds on desktop. Mobile residual issue is because the Nav element renders taller than the math assumed (logo + hamburger + py-4 padding pushes header bottom past 128px).
